newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market not tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry.
There were 15,900 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 13,400 formulated and 2,500 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Confirmed - None Week Ago - 16,100 Year Ago - 3,300
Wk to Date - 15,900 Week Ago - 40,000 Year Ago - 88,900
